terminal.writingHint: Typing: your keys go to the agent.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Every open agent, side by side.
sessions.empty: No open sessions. Start an agent from a task.

activate.title: Activate Truehand in {name}
activate.intro: Truehand adds to the repository the rules to move from one state to the next and two git checks. Review everything before activating.
activate.baseHint: Each task's changes are measured from here.
activate.hooksHint: commit-msg checks commit messages, pre-push blocks the push when the proofs do not hold.
activate.force: Replace the existing check with Truehand's. The old one stops working.
activate.rulesHint: Which checks each step needs. Rules are validated before saving.
activate.queued: Rules queued: confirm them on the Mac.
activate.rulesLater: The rules are created on activation with the recommended checks: right after, you review and edit them here.
activate.commitHint: Rules and approvers count for tasks (and CI) only once they are on the base branch. Check what changes: exactly this text is committed, nothing else.
activate.approvers: Who will be able to approve
activate.noApprovers: No approvers: approvals stay with this Mac's Touch ID, unsigned.
activate.noChanges: No text differences against the base branch.
activate.pushBase: Committed locally: push {base}, tasks start from the remote branch.
activate.saveFirst: Save your edits first: only the saved text shown here is committed.
activate.queuedStale: The file changed after the request: confirming would be refused. Cancel it and ask again.
activate.pushTitle: The rules are not on {base} yet
activate.pushHint: The rules are committed on the local branch: they count for tasks and CI only once they reach the remote. Below is what the push will bring.

remote.offHint: Truehand answers only on this Mac.
remote.tailnetHint: Truehand also listens on the tailnet address: only your Tailscale devices, never the internet.
remote.tailscale-serveHint: Published by Tailscale with HTTPS on your tailnet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.permissionHint: How every new session starts. Never without permissions.
settings.macOnly: Can be changed only from the Mac.
settings.removeHint: Removing a project only removes it from Truehand: the files stay where they are.
settings.claudeMissing: Not found. Install Claude Code and reopen Truehand.
settings.ghLogin: Installed but not connected: run gh auth login
settings.ghMissing: Not found: needed to open PRs
settings.globalPlugin: The Truehand plugin is also installed in Claude Code: sessions opened outside this app use that copy.
settings.rotateHint: The Mac app gets a new token; paired phones stay paired.
settings.sessionsUnavailable: Agents cannot start: Truehand runs read-only or inside an agent session.

pair.title: Pair a phone
pair.intro: The phone sees the board, follows the agents and answers them. Approvals and pushes are still confirmed here on the Mac.
pair.step1: On the phone, connected to the tailnet, open
pair.step2: Scan the QR or type the code.
pair.qrAlt: QR code to pair the phone
pair.security: The code works once, for 2 minutes. The phone gets its own access, which you can revoke from the settings.
pair.phoneIntro: Enter the code shown on the Mac, in Settings → Pair a phone.
pair.invalid: Invalid or expired code: generate a new one on the Mac.
pair.tooMany: Too many tries: wait a minute and make a new code.
pair.tokenTitle: On the Mac in a browser?
pair.tokenHint: Paste the Truehand app token (in the app menu). This page does not keep it.

newTask.title: New task
newTask.name: Title

newTask.descriptionPlaceholder: Context, expected behaviour, useful links. Markdown supported.
newTask.ticketHint: If set, the agent reads the ticket to prepare the plan.
newTask.ticketError: Task created, but the ticket could not be read: {error}
newTask.worktreeHint: So several agents can work in parallel without stepping on each other.
newTask.scopeHint: One per line, e.g. lib/auth/**. Empty = all

addProject.pathHint: A git folder in your home.
addProject.name: Project name

machine.title: Machines
machine.hint: Projects on other computers reached over ssh (tailnet too). Agents run there, you follow them from here.
machine.sshHint: As you type it with ssh: a name in ~/.ssh/config or a tailnet address.
machine.label: Name
machine.offlineHint: The machine does not answer: tasks stay visible but agents cannot start.

sendBack.tellAgent: Tell the agent in its terminal
sendBack.agentNote: The task went back to “{state}”: read the last comment.

invisible.warning: Invisible characters in the text: {n}. Approving approves them too.

err.already-merged: The task is already merged into the base branch: nothing to push.
err.no-remote: The repository has no “origin” remote: add one to push.
err.remote-not-github: “origin” is a local folder: a pull request needs a GitHub remote.
err.gh-missing: gh (GitHub CLI) is missing on this Mac: install it and run “gh auth login”.
err.gh-auth: gh can't reach GitHub: run “gh auth login” on the Mac and try again.
err.config-not-committed: The rules (.truehand/config.yaml) are not committed on the base branch: task folders start from there. Commit them first.
err.config-not-pushed: The rules are committed locally but not on the remote: push the base branch, tasks start from there.
err.no-approvers: The base branch config lists no approvers: add this Mac's key and commit the rules.
err.config-changed: The config changed since you read it: reloaded. Read it again and retry.
err.not-on-base: Check out {base} first: the rules are committed there.
err.other-changes-staged: Other changes are staged: commit or unstage them first.
err.remote-unavailable: Saved, but access from other devices did not start: {error}
